name: Incredible Dracula: License to Relax - Collector's Edition
storyline:
Step into a fantastical world where Count Dracula unexpectedly inherits the Dark Dreams Hotel - once a radiant jewel of the resort industry, now a shadow of its former self. What begins as a hopeful venture into restoring a grand legacy soon spirals into an unforeseen challenge filled with rivals, secrets, and unexpected allies. It's up to you to help Dracula navigate this tangled journey.

From reviving the hotel's splendor and outsmarting scheming competitors to unearthing hidden mysteries lurking within the eerie grounds, the stakes couldn't be higher! Employ strategic resource management, recruit legendary experts to assist in your endeavors, and prepare the hotel for an unforgettable grand reopening. But the path isn't without hurdles - the Ministry of Control and Prohibition looms large, presenting a gauntlet of impossible demands threatening Dracula's progress.
summary: Prepare the Dark Dreams Hotel for its grand reopening in this time management game.
